versos.texto_bv: e lhe suplicavam que apenas pudessem tocar a borda do seu manto; e todos os que tocaram foram curados.
versos.traducao_literal: e suplicavam-lhe que somente tocassem a borda do manto dele; e quantos tocaram foram completamente curados.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0026): O verbo grego διασῴζω (aoristo passivo, prefixo intensivo δια-) marca 'ficar completamente/perfeitamente são/salvo', reproduzido pela tradução_literal ('completamente curados') e pela KJV ('made perfectly whole'). O texto_bv atual, 'foram curados', omite esse grau de intensidade. — evidência: lemma διασῴζω/V-API-3P (não o simples σῴζω); tradução_literal: 'foram completamente curados'; KJV: 'were made perfectly whole'.

kjv.texto: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

vizinhos.35: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

web.texto: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

vizinhos.35: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick,
